Package wellen

Class ToneEngineMIDI

java.lang.Object
wellen.ToneEngine
wellen.ToneEngineMIDI
public class ToneEngineMIDI extends ToneEngine
implementation of ToneEngine sending MIDI messages to external MIDI devices. instrument IDs are used as MIDI channels.

  • Field Details

    • SEND_NOTE_OFF_TO_ALL

      public static boolean SEND_NOTE_OFF_TO_ALL
      if true note_off() additionally sends a note-off message for every note ( 0–127 ) on the current channel. use this for devices that ignore all notes off ( CC 123 ).

    • note_on_instrument

      public void note_on_instrument(int instrument_id, int note, int velocity)
      Description copied from class: ToneEngine
      play a note on a specific instrument without changing the currently selected instrument. unlike the combination of instrument(int) and note_on(int, int) this method is safe to call from different threads at the same time ( e.g from a MIDI callback and from draw() ).
      Overrides:
      note_on_instrument in class ToneEngine
      Parameters:
      instrument_id - ID of instrument
      note - pitch of note ranging from 0 to 127
      velocity - volume of note ranging from 0 to 127
